explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a large road vehicle carrying passengers on a fixed route, a common form of mass transit.

clue.text: Advent calendar to be opened outside home — wow!

indicators.note: an opening is a beginning, so only the first letter is kept
being outside means surrounding, so one piece wraps the other

blocks.note: the opening letter of calendar
OMG, oh my God, is an exclamation of amazement
at home is in

explanation.surface: Excitement at an Advent calendar waiting to be opened at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advent calendar' looks like one item, but Advent is the definition on its own; the calendar supplies only its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Advent comes from Latin for arrival, and the season marks the approaching arrival of Christ at Christmas.

clue.text: Second present, mum’s new “single white male”, outside

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for second
the present is now
ma is mum
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Mum's second present is a new lonely-hearts date waiting outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift; it is the time. 'Single white male' is lonely-hearts language, read literally.
explanation.definitionFit: A solitary figure built of snow stands in the garden, white and male, so it is a wry description of a frosty figure.

clue.text: Without thinking properly, nurses got off

indicators.note: to nurse something is to hold it close, so one piece is cradled inside another

blocks.note: doing something properly is doing it competently
got off, as in dispatched or posted, means sent

explanation.surface: Nurses absent-mindedly clocked off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nurses' looks like the hospital staff; it is the verb, hugging a piece inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with your mind elsewhere means acting in a distracted, inattentive manner.

clue.text: Right parts to be bought in spring

indicators.note: to part something is to split it, so one piece goes into the gap

blocks.note: R is the abbreviation for right
a venal person can be bought, as with a bribe

explanation.surface: The correct components are bought in the springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parts' looks like components; it is a verb, splitting the corrupt word.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal comes from the Latin for the season of new growth, describing things belonging to that time of year.
